This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Mando 16" />

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their mottled skin and enlarged [[Nose|nasal bridges]].<ref name="Mando 16" />

==Species in the galaxy==
In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{MandoDate|16}}</ref> a member of this species was present at [[Lafete diner|diner]] on the [[planet]] [[Lafete]] when [[Din Djarin]] and [[Boba Fett]] arrived to ask [[Bo-Katan Kryze]] and [[Koska Reeves]] for help in [[Second rescue of Grogu|rescuing]] [[Din Grogu|Grogu]] from the clutches of [[Moff]] [[Gideon]].<ref name="Mando 16" />

==Behind the scenes==
This species first appeared in the [[Chapter 16: The Rescue|eighth episode]] of the [[The Mandalorian Season Two|second season]] of the television series, ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]],'' directed by [[Peyton Reed]].<ref name="Mando 16" />
